### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines?

- Set paths

```{r}
analysis_path <- "02-differential-expression-profiling"
```


### 1.0 Extract ALS vs Control genes affected by ERAP2 KD

- Write list of 163 differentially expressed genes in als vs control affected by ERAP2 KD. 


```{r}

candidate_genes_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-significantly-affected-genes-by-kd-in-als-vs-control.rds"))
write.table(x = candidate_genes_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "01-significantly-differentially-expressed-genes-in-als-vs-control-affected-by-erap2-kd.txt"),
        quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T, sep = "\t")

```

### 1.0 Extract Control genes affected by ERAP2 KD


- Write list of 474 differentially expressed genes affected by ERAP2 KD in control. 


```{r}

candidate_genes_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "01-significantly-differentially-expressed-genes-pval-less-than-0.05.RDS"))
candidate_genes_df <- candidate_genes_df[candidate_genes_df$contrasts == "erap2_kd_effect_in_control" &
        !is.na(candidate_genes_df$gene_name),]
write.table(x = candidate_genes_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "01-significantly-differentially-expressed-genes-by-erap2-kd-in-control-cells.txt"),
        quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T, sep = "\t")

```
